title: Only 3% Of Eligible People Donate Blood
hook: Most people assume eligible donors give; only 3% do.
closing: Hospitals need more eligible people to become regular blood donors.
question: Would you donate blood?

segments.say: Only 3 percent of eligible people donate blood, leaving hospitals dependent on a tiny volunteer pool.
Blood donor volume fell to an index of 60, so fewer people are replacing the donors hospitals rely on.
